test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'TRUST' is written as 'UQVRU' and 'FAITH' is written as 'GZJSI'. How will 'LOVELY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is 

For, "TRUST" is written as "UQVRU"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e42bd2194ffe35b0b10e666a91d0686a02531dea5307b97e464c1f3b689ff85.png] 

For, "FAITH" is written as "GZJSI"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bca34508a834a1c1158b4373ca24fd266b4ae83377c65cd76dfd9cad9460767.png] 

Similarly for **"LOVELY" **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7959ccee7696e9caa0b2bf64275a69d2ebb2c371b965f643b0bc9605be3297b0.png] 

So,** "LOVELY" will be written as "MNWDMX"**

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 1."**
